subject: a 13th-century Persian Muslim scholar and poet of Konya with a full dark beard, a large wrapped white turban, a long dark wool scholar's robe over a pale tunic, gentle thoughtful eyes and a calm, warm face

panels.01-road: a long caravan of a scholar's family and students with camels, mules and laden carts crossing a dry mountain pass in Central Asia and Persia around 1218, a small boy in a turban riding beside his father, distant snowy peaks, wide establishing shot, a journey into the unknown
panels.02-konya: the Seljuk city of Konya in Anatolia in 1228, mud-brick and stone houses, a Seljuk mosque with a minaret and a carved stone portal, a citadel hill, travellers arriving through a city gate at golden hour, wide establishing shot
panels.03-teacher: {S} seated on a low platform teaching a large circle of students in turbans in the stone courtyard of a Seljuk madrasa in 1240, open books and reed pens, arched iwan behind, a scholar at work, respectful and calm
panels.04-shams: {S} meeting an older wandering dervish in a rough dark felt cloak with a lean weathered face in a busy caravanserai courtyard in Konya in 1244, merchants and camels in the background, a moment of surprise and deep attention between the two men
panels.05-divan: {S} at night by an oil lamp in a simple room, writing lines of poetry with a reed pen on paper, a musician in the shadows quietly playing a ney reed flute, longing and focus, Konya 1249, lit by a small flat clay oil lamp with an open flame, no glass lamp, no lamp chimney
panels.06-masnavi: an older {S} with grey in his beard walking slowly and speaking aloud among grape vines and almond trees in the Meram vineyards outside Konya in 1258, a younger student scribe in a turban walking beside him writing on paper held against a board, soft late light, the making of a great poem
panels.07-farewell: a vast funeral procession in Konya in December 1273, a shrouded bier carried on shoulders through narrow medieval Seljuk streets of mud-brick and stone houses with wooden balconies, mourners of many faiths walking together, Muslims, Christians and Jews in 13th-century robes and turbans, winter light, no wires, no poles, no awnings, no shop signs
panels.08-ney: Mevlevi dervishes of the late 13th century in Konya, men wearing tall conical camel-hair felt hats (sikke) and long white robes with dark cloaks, one playing a long reed flute (ney) and one a frame drum, sitting in a stone courtyard beside a tomb with a turquoise dome, calm devotion, no brimmed hats
